entities.summary: Galveias is a civil parish in the municipality of Ponte de Sor, in the Portuguese northern Alentejo, district of Portalegre. The population in 2011 was 1,061, in an area of 79.83 km2. The small parish developed under the patronage of Order of Aviz, endowments from the Marquês Ratão family.
